**Finding: compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).

The agreement contains no Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, cancellation charge, or minimum/early-termination fee:

- **§11 (p0084)** obliges Sparkling only to pay the fees in the Fee Schedule — no stipulated damages or late-payment interest mechanic anywhere in the document.
- **§17(b) (p0118)** grants Sparkling a clean termination-for-convenience right on 90 days' notice, with no exit fee or minimum-commitment buyout.
- **§17(c) (p0128)** on termination for Garman's default runs money *toward* us (fee refund plus conversion to a perpetual fee-free licence) — favourable to our party, so not flagged.
- **§15 (p0105)** limits both parties to direct damages, with no stipulated-sum carve-out against us.

This sits at the **preferred** position, not merely the fallback, so no redline was proposed.
